entity.name: Sundaresh Prasanna
entity.description: Data Scientist and software engineer based in Chennai, building open-source civic technology for water intelligence and climate resilience.

projects.name: Neer Vazhvu
projects.description: Open-source water intelligence platform for Chennai that connects 6 public datasets - reservoirs, groundwater, river quality, flood risk, drainage, and water bodies - into ward-level summaries with AI narratives in English and Tamil. Covers all 200 wards, runs daily automated pipelines, mobile-first.

channels.description: Open to grants and institutional funding for multi-city expansion and community partnerships.

plans.name: Infrastructure sustenance
plans.description: Cover monthly running costs - AI API, domain, and hosting when traffic exceeds free tier. Currently ~$6/month ($72/year).

plans.name: Multi-city expansion
plans.description: Fund data pipeline development for Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and other water-stressed Indian cities. Includes data source research, scraper development, and localization.
